description: This file defines a helper module for Google Workspace workflows, including command-line interface commands and handlers for various high-level productivity actions such as generating reports, preparing meetings, converting emails to tasks, weekly summaries, and announcing files in chat spaces.

classes.name: WorkflowHelper
classes.description: A helper struct implementing the Helper trait to inject commands and handle subcommands related to Google Workspace workflows.

methods.name: inject_commands
methods.description: Injects subcommands into a CLI command for various workflow helpers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles subcommands asynchronously, dispatching to specific handler functions based on matched subcommand.

methods.name: helper_only
methods.description: Indicates that this helper is for CLI only.

methods.name: build_standup_report_cmd
methods.description: Builds the CLI command for generating a standup report.

methods.name: build_meeting_prep_cmd
methods.description: Builds the CLI command for preparing a meeting.

methods.name: build_email_to_task_cmd
methods.description: Builds the CLI command for converting an email into a task.

methods.name: build_weekly_digest_cmd
methods.description: Builds the CLI command for generating a weekly digest.

methods.name: build_file_announce_cmd
methods.description: Builds the CLI command for announcing a Drive file in chat.

methods.name: get_json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and parses the JSON response.

methods.name: format_and_print
methods.description: Formats a JSON value according to user-specified output format and prints it.

methods.name: handle_standup_report
methods.description: Fetches today's calendar events and open tasks, then outputs a summary.

methods.name: handle_meeting_prep
methods.description: Fetches the next upcoming calendar event and its attendees, outputs details.

methods.name: handle_email_to_task
methods.description: Fetches an email by message ID and creates a Google Task from it.

methods.name: handle_weekly_digest
methods.description: Fetches this week's calendar events and unread email count, outputs a summary.

methods.name: handle_file_announce
methods.description: Fetches Drive file metadata and posts an announcement message in a chat space.

methods.name: epoch_to_rfc3339
methods.description: Converts a Unix epoch timestamp to RFC3339 formatted string.
